decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a broad range of Bluetooth speakers, from the high-end Sony SRS-RA3000 home system to the portable industry standards like the JBL Flip 5 and Charge 5. While the JBL models have excellent reputations and ratings, I was looking for a specific combination of high-fidelity home audio and seamless smart-assistant integration that doesn't rely heavily on a companion smartphone app. The Sony model had mixed reviews regarding its connectivity app, and the iHome model lacked some native Alexa features. Given that none of the premium options perfectly met my specific criteria for a stationary home smart speaker, I have decided not to make a purchase during this session.
